C0.loc: Abstract, p. 1593; Sec. 1 Introduction; Sec. 4, pp. 1595-1596
C0.quote: we propose using ranking queries repeatedly and to aggregate the queries
C0.note: ML rank aggregation: the 'voters' are repeated answer rankings sampled from a single LLM (ChatGPT), merged with Partial Borda to make LLM query answers robust; not several agents' inputs to a collective decision. Codebook lists ML rank aggregation as INELIG.
